scope: Selected carrying subassemblies for the approved above-core arrangement. Ownership follows the mounting parent, never a coordinate quadrant. A proposed or modelled retaining detail does not authorize changing the assigned carrying piece.
implementation_rule: Preserve the selected component arrangement, carrying pieces and boundary connections. Resolve retaining details within that arrangement. Any necessary change to attachment, main component position or routing that introduces a compromise must be discussed with Derek before adoption.

groups.basis: Funnel frame and retained front manifold carried by front-top
V-B seats in a visible upright wall rooted in the cold-core roof. Production fusion and installed retention remain pending.
Integral back-top wall or rear-panel attachment
Mean Well base faces the west dry sidewall below the raised relays; its wall mounts and supply travel with back-top.
Attached to a back-top valve or rear fitting; travels with that subassembly
Water inlet group carried with back-top's valve seats and inlet; independent retention is to design
V-A feed carried with its valve, with the final connection made at front-top's Y-A
CO2 inlet fold carried with the rear-panel connection; independent retention is to design
Mounted on the cold-core top; core is carried by back-bottom; local fasteners are to design
Attached to the core-mounted pump and carried with back-bottom
Flow meter, continuous insulated inlet and concealed rear outlet join carried with back-top; inlet tube crosses the plain cold-core guide at final connection.

boundary_handoffs.note: Back-top low V-A feed connects directly to front-top Y-A stem elbow
Back-bottom V-B inlet tube connects to the front-top funnel drain outlet
Back-bottom V-B return tube connects to the front-top Y-B elbow
Back-top's V-K inlet chain connects to the back-bottom pump
Rear-panel CO2 fold connects to the back-bottom cold core
Back-top meter inlet enters the back-bottom cold core through a plain guide. This is one continuous tube, not a socket, joint or cut; flexible handling and final insertion belong to assembly staging.

connection_owner_rule: Mating housings and local conductors inherit their component's assembly owner. This does not claim a complete end-to-end harness route.
